risks.risk: The tires may be worn or flat, affecting usability.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tire treads and sidewalls, showing depth and condition.

risks.risk: The frame or fork may have cracks or bends not visible in the current photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the frame, especially near the head tube and bottom bracket, under good lighting.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
